title: Lightheadedness when standing up
source: CrewCare team, FICTIONAL document created for the NASA Space Apps 2026 demonstration. Not from a clinical source.

approval.note: FICTIONAL PROTOCOL, NOT APPROVED. Used only to demonstrate the application workflow. Not for medical decisions.

summary: Recording episodes of lightheadedness on standing and reducing the risk of falls or injury.

sections.heading: When it applies
sections.body: Standing tolerance is reduced or poor, systolic pressure is below 90 mmHg, or the crew member reports lightheadedness on standing.

sections.heading: Crew steps (fictional)
sections.body:
1. Change position slowly and hold a handrail.
2. Record when the episode happened and how long it lasted.
3. Take a manual blood-pressure reading at rest and enter it in the console.
4. Log fluid intake for the day.
5. Tell the CMO before any strenuous task or spacewalk preparation.
